steps.what: Capture factual attendance, completion and authorised assessment information
Transfer source entries into the required student records register
Check student records for completeness and resolve discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure one-time entry in {LMS} and native transfer into {OTHER}, the pupil information system. Keep factual capture, authorised-grade verification and completeness checks with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning records may be re-entered in a separate official register.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed native exports can map agreed fields without retyping.
tasks.still_hard: A matched student identifier does not establish that the source entry is accurate.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise inconsistent attendance or completion evidence and correct it responsibly.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate record entry; accuracy responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: ParnasSys offers pupil records and learning-goal tracking; this supports the records-system category, not this school's integration.
Removing duplicate transfer through native mappings is an E1 scenario conditional on an actual second-entry requirement.

assumptions: Boundary is recording and maintaining facts, excluding the teaching, attendance observation and assessment decisions that produce them.

The teacher produces student ID, activity ID, date, attendance status, completion state and authorised grade version in s1. All 50 hours remain for capture and checking against source evidence; assessment judgement is owned by its assessment task rather than saved here.
The school administrator supplies existing register definitions. s2 maps only verified fields; missing IDs, conflicting grade versions or unknown statuses return to s3 manual correction.
Test native exports before custom integration. Existing single-entry systems earn no new saving. Added mapping maintenance is counted below.
unknowns: Native export support and register requirements
research_questions: Can a parallel register transfer remove retyping without increasing source capture or correction time?

incremental.description: Maintain mappings and investigate posting exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact student rows, dates, statuses and authorised grade versions after discrepancy resolution; edits void confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+0+20=70; gross 30%, minus four focal upkeep gives 26% central net. Low assumes ten duplicate-entry hours removable; source capture and verification remain full.

tasks.short: Plan and conduct balanced vocational activities

steps.what: Plan activities balancing instruction, demonstration and student investigation

loop.purpose: Draft an activity sequence around teacher-selected outcomes and workshop constraints
loop.input: Teacher brief, approved activities, duration and equipment limits
loop.output: Proposed sequence with demonstration, work and questioning opportunities
loop.check: Teacher verifies each activity practises the intended skill, includes safe prerequisites and allows meaningful student investigation
loop.stop: One revision then manual planning if practical or safety assumptions remain wrong
loop.why_not_simpler: A timetable template cannot draft varied practical activities and useful questions

steps.what: Conduct instruction and demonstrations and guide students' practical investigation

tasks.design: Reuse activity banks in {DOCS}, with a bounded draft for teacher-selected practical outcomes and available workshop time. The teacher approves feasibility and safety and retains every demonstration, question and supervision interaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a balanced activity sequence repeats preparation work while workshop constraints vary.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-limited drafts can organise known activities without deciding the learning outcome.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible sequence may assume unavailable tools or unsafe student independence.
tasks.human_edge: Connect demonstration to actual student understanding and safe practical work.
tasks.altitude: Less activity-plan drafting; live instruction and workshop authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm equipment readiness for practical learning
reach.learn: Tool availability and safe operating prerequisites

evidence.claim: Teacher-reviewed vocational activity sequencing is an E1 design; general planning-study results are not transferred to live workshop teaching.

assumptions: Boundary is activity planning and delivery, excluding formal tests and routine class-work marking assigned to separate tasks.

The teacher captures outcomes, duration, available tools, prerequisites and approved examples within 15 retained s1 hours, including correction and approval. Missing equipment or safety information requires manual planning.
Test native activity banks and templates first. The entire 75-hour delivery share remains human; no new student or technician capture duty is assumed.
unknowns: Current planning burden and approved activity resources
research_questions: Do draft sequences remain safe and workable while preserving student questioning and investigation?

already_counted.description: Planning brief, activity corrections and feasibility approval

incremental.description: Maintain activity guidance and review recurring draft errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact activity sequence, outcomes, equipment, timing and safety prerequisites; edits require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=15+75=90; gross 10%, minus three upkeep gives 7% central net. Low assumes four preparation hours removed; all direct practical teaching remains full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and administer tests and assess progress

steps.what: Prepare tests and formal assignments to evaluate specified vocational skills

loop.purpose: Draft assessment instructions from teacher-chosen outcomes and tasks
loop.input: Chosen vocational outcomes, approved examples and assessment constraints
loop.output: Draft instructions and criteria for teacher validation
loop.check: Teacher checks that tasks elicit the intended practical skill, are safe and feasible, and permit fair judgement
loop.stop: One revision then manual preparation if validity or safety is uncertain
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed templates format a test but cannot draft instructions for varied practical tasks

steps.what: Administer the test or formal practical assignment
Grade assessment evidence and evaluate the student's progress

tasks.design: Use native assessment templates in {DOCS}, with a bounded draft for instructions from teacher-chosen tasks and criteria. Keep practical administration, progress interpretation and every grade decision with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clear practical-test instructions require repeated writing and revision.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can reduce instruction wording while leaving assessment validity checks intact.
tasks.still_hard: A task may measure familiarity with instructions rather than the intended vocational skill.
tasks.human_edge: Observe technique and judge competent performance against the criteria.
tasks.altitude: Less test-brief drafting; assessment authority stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Criteria clarity and fair assessment conditions

evidence.claim: Drafting practical-test instructions while retaining teacher grading is an E1 design; no automatic practical assessment capability is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is formal tests and assessed practical assignments. Routine class work and homework belong to task 6680; the same marked submission must be assigned once in the roll-up.

The teacher supplies outcomes, chosen tasks, permitted tools, conditions and criteria in retained s1 time. All 15 hours include capture, correction and approval; absent safety or validity constraints require manual preparation.
Native assessment templates precede a loop. No student evidence is used by the drafting loop and no administration or grading time is reduced.
unknowns: Formal assessment mix and current brief-writing time
research_questions: Do reviewed briefs save wording time while eliciting the intended practical skill fairly?

already_counted.description: Assessment brief capture, correction and approval

incremental.description: Maintain approved assessment guidance and inspect draft errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact formal task, instructions, criteria, tools and assessment conditions; changes require renewed approval
Exact student evidence, criteria version and final result; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=15+30+45=90; gross 10%, minus three upkeep gives 7% central net. Low assumes four drafting hours removable; all formal administration and grading remain full.

tasks.short: Assign and grade routine class work and homework

steps.what: Assign selected class work and homework with clear instructions and deadlines
Grade class work and homework and give appropriate practical feedback

tasks.design: Reuse native {LMS} assignment templates for teacher-selected routine practice, preserving final instructions and recipient checks. Keep practical-work grading and individual feedback with the teacher; no model evaluates learning outcomes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated setup of similar practice assignments consumes screen-entry time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native assignment reuse can prefill stable instructions and submission settings.
tasks.still_hard: Practice work may reveal a misconception that needs contextual feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the student's method and explain how to improve it.
tasks.altitude: Less assignment setup; grading and feedback time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native assignment reuse can reduce repeated setup without changing teacher marking; the saving is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is issuing routine practice and marking it, excluding creation of new course materials and formal assessed work owned by task 6678.

The teacher selects task ID, class, deadline, instructions and submission settings within ten retained s1 hours, including final checks. The school administrator supplies the existing class roster through normal enrolment; no new student capture is required.
Missing roster entries or changed instructions require manual setup within s1. Test native assignment duplication before custom code; all 80 marking hours remain.
unknowns: Native assignment reuse and existing setup time
research_questions: Can native assignment reuse reduce setup after counting selection, deadline changes and recipient checks?

already_counted.description: Assignment selection, field changes and final release checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact practice task, instructions, class recipients, deadline and submission settings; changes require renewed confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=10+80=90; gross 10%, minus two upkeep gives 8% central net. Low assumes three setup hours removable; all grading and feedback remain full.

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate records, practical-plan drafts and assignment setup while retaining live teaching and vocational assessment.
reach: Work with workshop and assessment coordinators on safe, valid practical activities
role.ambitious_version: A vocational teacher who spends less time repeating entry and wording and retains attention to students' actual practical competence.
